name: RuggedArt
rootCause: In the function targetedPurchase(), an user could give an arbitrary swapParam which includes the field commands to 4. It then calls the UNIVERSAL_ROUTER.execute() function. According to the Uniswap Technical Reference, commands 4 is SWEEP and it will call the sweep() function. As pointed from the following figure, the sweep() function will send back ETH to the user contract and cause a re-entrancy issue. The ERC 404 project Rugged Art was attacked due to a reentrancy vulnerability, resulting in a loss of 11 ETH.

RuggedArt was exploited on Ethereum on 2024-02-19 through a reentrancy issue affecting staking and reward-related flows. Publicly available evidence is limited, but a linked attack transaction and published reproduction indicate the attacker repeatedly re-entered staking logic during an external callback and extracted roughly 5 ETH to 10 ETH worth of value. Available evidence indicates a reentrancy flaw in RuggedArt staking and reward handling. A published reproduction shows the attack contract re-entering stake() from a payable fallback during a purchase and unstake sequence, allowing state changes to be executed in an unsafe order.
